Rothschild & Ausbrooks, PLLC is a bankruptcy services provider listed in the CreditDoc directory. Because we could not verify the site, this page does not describe specific loan products, rates, or service details. Consumers considering Rothschild & Ausbrooks, PLLC should contact the company directly to confirm what services are currently offered and at what cost, and to request written disclosures for any product before signing.

Bankruptcy petition preparers and attorneys are regulated separately. Confirm attorney licensing via your state bar association; non-attorneys must comply with 11 USC §110 disclosure and fee limits.
